# Graph-Structured Agent Episodic and Semantic Memory Architecture

> Dual episodic-semantic memory architecture for autonomous agents with edge decay, hierarchical abstraction, and associative retrieval.

## Core Findings

- Structuring autonomous agent memory as a dual episodic-semantic knowledge graph separates temporal autobiographical episode sequences from abstracted entity knowledge, improving recall precision across multi-session horizons. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442]
- Decay-weighted edge traversal integrates recency, frequency, and emotional/task importance factors to prune inactive memory pathways while preserving reinforced causal connections. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442]
- Graph-based memory consolidation processes raw observation nodes through offline abstraction passes, merging duplicate entities and distilling high-order rules into permanent declarative nodes. [Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01720]
